notes.content:

[/list]

[url=http://marusexijaxs.web.fc2.com/]マルセ様[/url] and also
[url=https://twitter.com/hicchicc]患者長ひっく様[/url] for their work on optimizing the font for Orangeblood!

Thank you for your great work!

notes.title: Update: Vanilla skill buff, improved fullscreen mode, added help screen.
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

Thank you for playing Orangeblood.

This message is to inform you that a new update has gone live.
The following changes have been made in this patch.

[list]
[*]Vanilla’s Deadeye skill has improved and she is now able to fire 8 bullets.
[*]Screen blur when in fullscreen has been fixed.
[*]Added a help page to the Menu.
[*]EXP gained from post game dungeon enemies has been increased.
[/list]

Again, thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Regarding a Bug which prevents story progression.
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

We have identified and are currently fixing a bug that prevents story progression.
[list]
[*] Before obtaining the Quest item “Master Key”, if you take the elevator from the Sunrise Hotel Deck area to the 16F you will get stuck behind a one way door and will be unable to progress further.
[/list]
We are currently working on a fix for this bug so we recommend that you do not take this elevator to the 16F before obtaining the Master Key.

We apologize for this inconvenience and will be sure to fix this issue as soon as we are able.

We hope you continue enjoying Orangeblood and will work our hardest to provide the possible user experience possible.
